title: @ycforge/builders-core — artifact catalog, builder build_config schemas, BLC_* error code catalog
description: Machine-readable contract for the core builder package (spec 018): the builder-id → artifact-type catalog (forward contract for 019/021), JSON Schema drafts for the three app-level build_config shapes (versionless, per spec 011), the three Artifact.value shapes (IDEA §8), and the catalog of BLC_* builder diagnostics. Type references here mirror src/types.ts/src/catalog.ts/src/diagnostics.ts of @ycforge/builders-core (standalone structural types, no pilot imports).

buildEnv.description: Resolved Record<string,string> (spec 012); residual {{$...}} here is a D-3 violation (BLC_ENV_NOT_RESOLVED).

archivePath.description: Absolute path to the .zip inside outputDir.

image.description: Immutable digest form; mutable tags never appear here (FR-011).

directory.description: Absolute path to the static build output inside outputDir.

nestjsFunctionBuildConfig.title: app-level build_config for builder nestjs-function (versionless, spec 011)
nestjsFunctionBuildConfig.description: Unknown top-level keys are ignored (coexistence with B-shared fields such as openapi_entry).

dockerBuildConfig.title: app-level build_config for builder docker (versionless, spec 011)
dockerBuildConfig.description: Credentials are never part of the config (FR-012). image.repository is required (no reasonable default for a registry).

tag.description: Push tag; never used as the artifact image (only the digest form is).

viteBuildConfig.title: app-level build_config for builder vite (versionless, spec 011)

builder.description: Builder id that emitted the diagnostic.

field.description: build_config field / build_env var when applicable.

errorCodes.title: BLC_* error code catalog
errorCodes.description: Builder diagnostics of @ycforge/builders-core (spec 018 Key Entities). Compared via constants in src/diagnostics.ts, never string literals (Constitution V). Codes are additive and non-breaking; D-3 guard (BLC_ENV_NOT_RESOLVED) is the contract-violation detector for pilot spec 012.

BLC_INVALID_CONFIG.description: Known build_config field has an invalid type/value; missing image.repository; invalid tag; unsupported runtime (FR-004/009/014).

BLC_MISSING_SOURCE.description: sourcePath absent and build is ambiguous (all three builders).

BLC_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND.description: entry file referenced by build_config does not exist (FR-007).

BLC_BUILD_FAILED.description: Underlying build failed: esbuild error, docker CLI nonzero/unavailable, vite command failed, missing build output (FR-007/013/017).

BLC_ENV_NOT_RESOLVED.description: Residual {{$...}} in buildConfig/buildEnv — upstream interpolation contract violated (FR-019, D-3).

BLC_IMAGE_DIGEST_UNAVAILABLE.description: Push succeeded but digest not resolved from push output or docker inspect (FR-011).
